Name: Various Coal Ores
Author: Dojando
Description:
[b]For 1.6 use this mod instead 
[/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21507

This mod adds different Variations of Coal ore into the mines. 
Those Variations Include the default stone one added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966]Custom Ore Nodes[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] but also a lava rock and ice rock version for better looks, as well as a pure coal ore node that drops some extra coal. 


The Optional Extra version includes 3 other nodes, that are inspired by "Gems and Ore Nodes"
From minor to Major spoiler:
[spoiler]
Mudstone: Drops clay, with the chance of dropping an actual Mudstone[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Obsidian: Drops Obsidian. Has a 1 in 10 chance to also drop a diamond[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Prismatic Ore: Drops a prismatic shard.[/spoiler]

I have not made a playthrough with this mod yet, so it might be a little bit unbalanced and there might be the one or other bug.
However it shouldn't be too difficult to change the amount of ores that spawn. You can find the settings for that in the custom_ore_nodes.json.
For a detailed tutorial, check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966]Custom Ore node[/url] Mod page. 

I used the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12352]Gems And Ores Nodes[/url]" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48163703]Luiz0Fernando[/url] as a template but all the extra stones and stone processing is not in here. Only Coal.
